chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Ash-Ash'ari, from Ibn al-Qaddah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Eat the pomegranate with its dividing lining (membrane), for it is a tanning (healing/fortifying) for the stomach.

key_terms.الْمُزَّ: The pomegranate with its inner membrane/lining
key_terms.بِشَحْمِهِ: With its fat/membrane (referring to the inner lining)

ai.seo_question: What is the health benefit of eating pomegranate with its membrane according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the medicinal virtue of consuming the pomegranate with its inner membrane (*al-muzz*), describing it as a 'tanner' (*dibagh*) for the stomach. This metaphor draws on the traditional leather-tanning process, implying that the membrane's astringent properties tighten stomach tissues, reduce excess moisture, and aid in digestion, reflecting the Shia tradition of integrating practical health advice with spiritual and physical well-being.
